welcome_page.title: Walking: effort and improvements
welcome_page.description:
What slows you down on foot, what makes you give up and what would help you walk more. It takes about 3 minutes.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your answers have been saved. Thank you for your time.

sections.title: Before we start
sections.description: A few quick questions to put your answers in context.

questions.text: In a typical week, on how many days do you walk for at least 10 minutes to get somewhere? Include walking to a bus stop or station.

sections.title: What slows you down or stops you
sections.description: Tell us how these things affect your walking.

questions.text: Why do you usually walk? (Select all that apply)

options.text: To go to shops or services
To go to work or study
To reach a stop or station
To take or pick someone up

How much do slopes slow you down when you walk?
How important are benches or places to rest for you to complete your walk?

options.text: Essential: without them I can't walk that far

questions.text: How often do you decide not to walk after dark because you don't feel safe?
How often do you decide not to walk because it is too hot?
How often do you find it hard to find your way on foot because signs are missing or unclear?
Walking helps me stay physically fit.
Walking helps me feel better mentally.
What would most encourage you to walk more? (Up to 3)

options.text: Nothing, things are fine as they are
Pavements free of cars, bins and scooters
More trees, shade and green spaces
More benches and places to rest
Fewer bikes and e-scooters on pavements

it.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Le tue risposte sono state salvate. Grazie per il tuo tempo.
it.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Alcune domande veloci per inquadrare le tue risposte.
it.#In a typical week, on how many days do: In una settimana tipica, in quanti giorni cammini almeno 10 minuti per andare da qualche parte? Conta anche il tragitto fino a una fermata o stazione.
it.#What slows you down or stops you: Cosa ti rallenta o ti fa rinunciare
it.#<p>Tell us how these things affect your: Dicci come queste cose influiscono sul tuo camminare.
it.#Why do you usually walk? (Select all th: Per quali motivi cammini di solito? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#To go to shops or services: Per andare in negozi o servizi
it.#To go to work or study: Per andare al lavoro o a studiare
it.#To reach a stop or station: Per raggiungere una fermata o stazione
it.#For a walk or exercise: Per passeggiare o fare attività fisica
it.#To walk the dog: Per portare a spasso il cane
it.#How often do bad pavements or obstacles: Quanto spesso marciapiedi rovinati o ostacoli ti rallentano?
it.#How much do slopes slow you down when y: Quanto ti rallentano le salite quando cammini?
it.#How important are benches or places to: Quanto sono importanti le panchine o i punti di sosta per riuscire a completare il tuo percorso?
it.#Essential: without them I can't walk th: Indispensabili: senza non riesco a camminare così a lungo
it.#How often do you decide not to walk aft: Quanto spesso decidi di non camminare dopo il tramonto perché non ti senti al sicuro?
it.#How often do you decide not to walk bec: Quanto spesso decidi di non camminare perché fa troppo caldo?
it.#How often do you find it hard to find y: Quanto spesso fai fatica a orientarti a piedi perché le indicazioni mancano o non sono chiare?
Camminare mi aiuta a restare in forma.
Camminare mi aiuta a stare meglio con la testa.
it.#What would most encourage you to walk m: Cosa ti incoraggerebbe di più a camminare di più? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Pavements free of cars, bins and scoote: Marciapiedi liberi da auto, cassonetti e monopattini
it.#Slower traffic (e.g. 30 km/h streets): Traffico più lento (ad es. strade a 30 km/h)
it.#More benches and places to rest: Più panchine e punti di sosta
it.#Fewer bikes and e-scooters on pavements: Meno bici e monopattini sui marciapiedi
it.#<p>What slows you down on foot, what ma:
Cosa ti rallenta a piedi, cosa ti fa rinunciare e cosa ti aiuterebbe a camminare di più. Richiede circa 3 minuti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Vos réponses ont été enregistrées. Merci pour votre temps.
fr.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Quelques questions rapides pour mettre vos réponses en contexte.
fr.#In a typical week, on how many days do: Au cours d’une semaine type, combien de jours marchez-vous au moins 10 minutes pour vous rendre quelque part ? Comptez aussi la marche jusqu’à un arrêt de bus ou une gare.
fr.#What slows you down or stops you: Ce qui vous ralentit ou vous arrête
fr.#<p>Tell us how these things affect your: Dites-nous comment ces éléments influencent vos déplacements à pied.
fr.#Why do you usually walk? (Select all th: Pourquoi marchez-vous habituellement ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#To go to shops or services: Pour aller dans des commerces ou des services
fr.#To go to work or study: Pour aller au travail ou au lieu d’études
fr.#To reach a stop or station: Pour rejoindre un arrêt ou une gare
fr.#To take or pick someone up: Pour accompagner ou aller chercher quelqu’un
fr.#To visit people: Pour rendre visite à des personnes
fr.#For a walk or exercise: Pour une promenade ou de l’exercice
fr.#How often do bad pavements or obstacles: À quelle fréquence des trottoirs en mauvais état ou des obstacles vous ralentissent-ils ?
fr.#How much do slopes slow you down when y: Dans quelle mesure les pentes vous ralentissent-elles lorsque vous marchez ?
fr.#How important are benches or places to: Quelle importance ont pour vous les bancs ou les endroits où se reposer pour terminer votre trajet à pied ?
fr.#Essential: without them I can't walk th: Essentiels : sans eux, je ne peux pas marcher aussi loin
fr.#How often do you decide not to walk aft: À quelle fréquence décidez-vous de ne pas marcher après la tombée de la nuit parce que vous ne vous sentez pas en sécurité ?
fr.#How often do you decide not to walk bec: À quelle fréquence décidez-vous de ne pas marcher parce qu’il fait trop chaud ?
fr.#How often do you find it hard to find y: À quelle fréquence avez-vous du mal à vous orienter à pied parce que la signalisation est absente ou peu claire ?
Marcher m’aide à rester en forme physiquement.
Marcher m’aide à me sentir mieux mentalement.
fr.#What would most encourage you to walk m: Qu’est-ce qui vous encouragerait le plus à marcher davantage ? (Jusqu’à 3)
fr.#Pavements free of cars, bins and scoote: Des trottoirs sans voitures, poubelles ni trottinettes
fr.#Slower traffic (e.g. 30 km/h streets): Une circulation plus lente (p. ex. rues à 30 km/h)
fr.#More trees, shade and green spaces: Plus d’arbres, d’ombre et d’espaces verts
fr.#More benches and places to rest: Plus de bancs et d’endroits pour se reposer
fr.#Fewer bikes and e-scooters on pavements: Moins de vélos et de trottinettes électriques sur les trottoirs
fr.#Clearer signs and maps: Une signalisation et des plans plus clairs
fr.#<p>What slows you down on foot, what ma:
Ce qui vous ralentit à pied, ce qui vous fait renoncer et ce qui vous aiderait à marcher davantage. Cela prend environ 3 minutes.

La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas liées à votre nom. Elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#SmartUrbanity - Walking: effort and imp: SmartUrbanity - Zu Fuß gehen: Aufwand und Verbesserungen
de.#Walking: effort and improvements: Zu Fuß gehen: Aufwand und Verbesserungen
de.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Ihre Antworten wurden gespeichert. Vielen Dank für Ihre Zeit.
de.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Ein paar kurze Fragen, um Ihre Antworten einzuordnen.
de.#In a typical week, on how many days do: An wie vielen Tagen einer typischen Woche gehen Sie mindestens 10 Minuten zu Fuß, um irgendwohin zu gelangen? Zählen Sie auch den Weg zu einer Haltestelle oder einem Bahnhof mit.
de.#<p>Tell us how these things affect your: Sagen Sie uns, wie sich diese Dinge auf Ihr Zufußgehen auswirken.
de.#Why do you usually walk? (Select all th: Warum gehen Sie normalerweise zu Fuß? (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)
de.#To go to shops or services: Um zu Geschäften oder Dienstleistungen zu gelangen
de.#To go to work or study: Um zur Arbeit oder zum Studien-/Schulort zu gelangen
de.#To reach a stop or station: Um eine Haltestelle oder einen Bahnhof zu erreichen
de.#To take or pick someone up: Um jemanden zu bringen oder abzuholen
de.#To walk the dog: Um mit dem Hund Gassi zu gehen
de.#How often do bad pavements or obstacles: Wie oft bremsen Sie schlechte Gehwege oder Hindernisse aus?
de.#How much do slopes slow you down when y: Wie stark bremsen Sie Steigungen beim Zufußgehen aus?
de.#How important are benches or places to: Wie wichtig sind für Sie Bänke oder Rastmöglichkeiten, um Ihren Weg zu Fuß zu schaffen?
de.#Essential: without them I can't walk th: Unverzichtbar: ohne sie kann ich nicht so weit gehen
de.#How often do you decide not to walk aft: Wie oft entscheiden Sie sich, nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit nicht zu Fuß zu gehen, weil Sie sich nicht sicher fühlen?
de.#How often do you decide not to walk bec: Wie oft entscheiden Sie sich, nicht zu Fuß zu gehen, weil es zu heiß ist?
de.#How often do you find it hard to find y: Wie oft fällt es Ihnen schwer, sich zu Fuß zurechtzufinden, weil Wegweiser fehlen oder unklar sind?
Zufußgehen hilft mir, körperlich fit zu bleiben.
Zufußgehen hilft mir, mich seelisch besser zu fühlen.
de.#What would most encourage you to walk m: Was würde Sie am meisten dazu ermutigen, mehr zu Fuß zu gehen? (Bis zu 3)
de.#Nothing, things are fine as they are: Nichts, es ist gut so, wie es ist
de.#Pavements free of cars, bins and scoote: Gehwege frei von Autos, Abfallbehältern und E-Scootern
de.#Fewer bikes and e-scooters on pavements: Weniger Fahrräder und E-Scooter auf den Gehwegen
de.#<p>What slows you down on foot, what ma:
Was Sie zu Fuß bremst, was Sie aufgeben lässt und was Ihnen helfen würde, mehr zu Fuß zu gehen. Es dauert etwa 3 Minuten.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf verschiedene SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

tr.#How often do bad pavements or obstacles: Bozuk kaldırımlar veya engeller sizi ne sıklıkla yavaşlatıyor?
tr.#How much do slopes slow you down when y: Yürürken yokuşlar sizi ne kadar yavaşlatıyor?

tr.#How often do you decide not to walk bec: Hava çok sıcak olduğu için ne sıklıkla yürümemeye karar veriyorsunuz?

Yürümek fiziksel olarak formda kalmama yardımcı oluyor.
Yürümek zihinsel olarak kendimi daha iyi hissetmeme yardımcı oluyor.
tr.#What would most encourage you to walk m: Daha fazla yürümeniz için sizi en çok ne teşvik ederdi? (En fazla 3)
tr.#Pavements free of cars, bins and scoote: Arabalardan, çöp kutularından ve scooterlardan arınmış kaldırımlar
tr.#More trees, shade and green spaces: Daha fazla ağaç, gölge ve yeşil alan
tr.#More benches and places to rest: Daha fazla bank ve dinlenme yeri
tr.#Fewer bikes and e-scooters on pavements: Kaldırımlarda daha az bisiklet ve elektrikli scooter
tr.#<p>What slows you down on foot, what ma:
Yürürken sizi ne yavaşlatıyor, ne vazgeçiriyor ve daha fazla yürümenize ne yardımcı olurdu. Yaklaşık 3 dakika sürer.

Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. E-posta adresinizden türetilen takma bir kod altında saklanır; böylece farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtlar birlikte analiz edilebilir.

fa.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: پاسخ‌های شما ذخیره شد. از وقتی که گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: چند پرسش کوتاه برای قراردادن پاسخ‌های شما در بستر مناسب.
fa.#In a typical week, on how many days do: در یک هفته معمولی، چند روز برای رسیدن به جایی دست‌کم ۱۰ دقیقه پیاده‌روی می‌کنید؟ پیاده‌روی تا ایستگاه اتوبوس یا قطار را هم حساب کنید.
fa.#What slows you down or stops you: چه چیزی شما را کند یا متوقف می‌کند
fa.#<p>Tell us how these things affect your: به ما بگویید این موارد چگونه بر پیاده‌روی شما اثر می‌گذارند.
fa.#Why do you usually walk? (Select all th: معمولاً به چه دلیل پیاده می‌روید؟ (همه موارد مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#To go to shops or services: برای رفتن به مغازه‌ها یا خدمات
fa.#To go to work or study: برای رفتن به محل کار یا تحصیل
fa.#How often do bad pavements or obstacles: پیاده‌روهای خراب یا موانع چند وقت یک‌بار شما را کند می‌کنند؟
fa.#How much do slopes slow you down when y: هنگام پیاده‌روی، سربالایی‌ها چقدر شما را کند می‌کنند؟
fa.#How important are benches or places to: نیمکت‌ها یا محل‌های استراحت برای اینکه بتوانید مسیر پیاده‌روی خود را کامل کنید چقدر برای شما مهم‌اند؟
fa.#Essential: without them I can't walk th: ضروری‌اند: بدون آن‌ها نمی‌توانم آن‌قدر پیاده بروم
fa.#How often do you decide not to walk aft: چند وقت یک‌بار به این دلیل که احساس امنیت نمی‌کنید، تصمیم می‌گیرید پس از تاریکی هوا پیاده نروید؟
fa.#How often do you decide not to walk bec: چند وقت یک‌بار به این دلیل که هوا خیلی گرم است، تصمیم می‌گیرید پیاده نروید؟
fa.#How often do you find it hard to find y: چند وقت یک‌بار به دلیل نبود یا نامشخص‌بودن تابلوها، پیدا کردن مسیر پیاده برایتان دشوار می‌شود؟
پیاده‌روی به من کمک می‌کند از نظر جسمی سرحال بمانم.
پیاده‌روی به من کمک می‌کند از نظر روحی حال بهتری داشته باشم.
fa.#What would most encourage you to walk m: چه چیزی بیش از همه شما را به پیاده‌روی بیشتر تشویق می‌کند؟ (حداکثر ۳ مورد)
fa.#Pavements free of cars, bins and scoote: پیاده‌روهای خالی از خودرو، سطل زباله و اسکوتر
fa.#Slower traffic (e.g. 30 km/h streets): ترافیک کندتر (مثلاً خیابان‌های ۳۰ کیلومتر بر ساعت)
fa.#More trees, shade and green spaces: درخت، سایه و فضای سبز بیشتر
fa.#Fewer bikes and e-scooters on pavements: دوچرخه و اسکوتر برقی کمتر روی پیاده‌روها
fa.#<p>What slows you down on foot, what ma:
چه چیزی هنگام پیاده‌روی شما را کند می‌کند، چه چیزی باعث می‌شود منصرف شوید و چه چیزی به شما کمک می‌کند بیشتر پیاده بروید. حدود ۳ دقیقه زمان می‌برد.

مشارکت داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شوند. آن‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما به دست می‌آید ذخیره می‌شوند تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.
